manual_fg_ducs_v1.transformation_boundary: The named parent supplies the case-study old/new plant, requirement, and controller material. The repository model manually introduces or revises explicit component-local transfer relations, individual requirement-boundary events, and FG-DUCS base/R1/R2 synthesis targets. The exact textual delta is the parent/adaptation diff; no automatic source-to-source transformation is claimed.

base.definition: No additional transition requirement is added to the model's declared FG-DUCS update problem.
base.interpretation: Reference condition for descriptive input-validity and terminal-classification comparison.

r1.definition: While a corresponding old/new requirement boundary is open, prohibit the model-specific new-side actions listed by that model's R1 transition properties.
r1.interpretation: Descriptive transition-safety condition; the exact action and property lists are model-specific and remain authoritative in each .lts file.

r2.definition: Require each associated old-requirement stop or new-requirement start event to occur before the component reconfiguration named by that model's R2 transition properties.
r2.interpretation: Descriptive requirement/component ordering condition; the exact event-to-component associations are model-specific and remain authoritative in each .lts file.

condition_design_note: Action counts, requirement-property counts, and affected component sets vary by model. The 27 base/R1/R2 model-condition cases are heterogeneous descriptive cases, not repeated observations of one controlled factor.

scope_note: These files are FG-DUCS adaptations maintained in this repository. They are not byte-identical copies of the upstream DUCS case-study archive. The fixed corpus is purposive and supports robustness descriptions, not population inference.

parent_distribution.reason: The eight unmodified DUCS parents are provenance references, not runtime inputs; the public artifact distributes the fixed FG-DUCS adaptations. Their permission scope is recorded separately in RIGHTS_REVIEW.md; provenance validation is not redistribution clearance.
